description: Purchased village architecture and a deliberately composed Merchants Lane: cooper deliveries, stacked merchandise, bakery supplies, an inn tasting table, source cloth bunting and street lamps. Every food and stacked crate has a measured real-mesh support; overhead ropes attach to actual façade triangles. Four existing travelers circulate on separate strips, total population 64; the main avenue and 806 metre walking loop remain open.

rejected_complete_castle_source.reason: The provided composite has disconnected elevated turret and wall masses, confirmed in neutral and native views. The complete original village_keep remains the live keep; purchased composite is retained for source assembly review.

authored_lanes.title: Merchants Lane
authored_lanes.description: A paved trading street with eleven staggered façades, three supported cloth-bunting spans and distinct near-field cooper, clothier, bakery and inn cargo pockets. Four existing travelers use separate return strips; total population remains 64.
